passages.label: Ambiguous credit match
passages.text: When two incoming bank credits have the same amount and posting day, request the bank trace from the processor before assigning either credit.

passages.label: No posted credit
passages.text: If an automatic payout has no posted bank credit, wait two business days after the expected posting date before opening a bank investigation.

passages.label: Same-day cutoff
passages.text: The submission cutoff for a same-day automatic payout is 14:30 UTC. Items submitted after the cutoff are handled the next business day.

passages.label: Rejected payout
passages.text: A rejected payout requires the bank's return reason and the original payout identifier before the amount can be released for retry.

passages.label: Value date
passages.text: Use the statement booking date for the close queue. Keep the value date as a separate field for the treasury statement.

passages.label: Truncated statement descriptor
passages.text: A clipped reference suffix is corroborating evidence only. A full end-to-end payment identifier is required for a unique assignment.

passages.label: Proof of delivery
passages.text: For a card-not-present merchandise-not-received chargeback, attach carrier delivery confirmation showing the delivery address and completion date.

passages.label: Acquirer dispute deadline
passages.text: Submit the evidence packet to the acquirer at least two business days before the case-specific response deadline in the dispute portal.

passages.label: Duplicate charge
passages.text: For a duplicate processing dispute, attach both authorization identifiers and the capture timestamps so the acquirer can distinguish the transactions.

passages.label: Refund proof
passages.text: For a credit-not-processed dispute, supply the settled refund reference and receipt timestamp. A pending refund receipt is insufficient.

passages.label: Issuer review window
passages.text: The issuer's decision window begins after the representment packet is accepted by the acquirer. Use the case-specific deadline in the dispute portal.

passages.label: Digital delivery
passages.text: For a digital service dispute, attach account access logs and activation details instead of a physical carrier receipt.

passages.label: Missing merchant refund
passages.text: When the processor settled a refund missing from the merchant ledger, retain the original purchase identifier, refund event and settlement line before requesting a ledger correction.

passages.label: Closed card account
passages.text: A refund must first be attempted on the original payment instrument. If the issuer returns it, escalate with the rejection reference to Payments Operations.

passages.label: Multiple partial refunds
passages.text: The sum of settled partial refunds cannot exceed the original captured purchase amount. Pending attempts are reviewed separately.

passages.label: Uncaptured authorization
passages.text: Void an uncaptured authorization to release the hold. A refund is available after capture.

passages.label: Refund batch cutoff
passages.text: The scheduled refund batch closes at 17:00 UTC. A refund initiated later enters the following business day's batch.

passages.label: Refund velocity release approval
passages.text: For a payout paused because refund velocity breached its alert limit, the release requires sign-off from Payments Risk.

passages.label: Identity verification release
passages.text: Compliance Operations clears holds linked to outstanding merchant identity verification after the case has the approved review decision.

passages.label: Rolling reserve release
passages.text: A reserve maturity releases on the next scheduled automatic payout after the ledger's reserve release event posts.

passages.label: Negative available balance
passages.text: If merchant available funds are negative, stop discretionary payout retries and open a Collections review with the current balance snapshot.

passages.label: Bank return rate freeze
passages.text: A high bank return rate freeze requires approval from Bank Risk before settlement can resume.

passages.label: Duplicate invoice debit
passages.text: Two invoice debits with the same invoice and amount require comparison of their bank references before a duplicate reversal is raised.

passages.label: Invoice fee breakdown
passages.text: A merchant requesting a fee breakdown receives the invoice identifier, the affected service codes and the billing period.

passages.label: Sales discount mismatch
passages.text: Attach the signed commercial amendment and invoice item before adjusting a fee that differs from the contracted discount.

passages.label: Line item rounding
passages.text: Round each taxable fee line to currency precision before summing the invoice. Retain the original unrounded taxable base for audit.

passages.label: Insufficient funds ACH return
passages.text: An R01 retry requires current authorization and a fresh available-balance check before resubmission.

passages.label: No account ACH return
passages.text: An R03 return goes to bank account correction. Do not resubmit until the replacement account is verified.

passages.label: Consumer disputes ACH debit
passages.text: Route an R10 consumer unauthorized debit to ACH Risk and suspend retries on the authorization until review is complete.

passages.label: Missing ACH return file
passages.text: If a return file is late, ask Bank Integrations for the file sequence number and processing acknowledgement.

passages.label: Domestic same-day ACH debit cutoff
passages.text: The domestic same-day ACH debit cutoff is 13:00 UTC. International transfers use a separate schedule.

passages.label: Corrected source file
passages.text: Preserve the original accepted input and store the corrected feed as a superseding snapshot with its own file digest and version.

passages.label: Exact import replay
passages.text: An identical input file for the same source is idempotent. The source digest is the replay key.

passages.label: Merchant close timezone
passages.text: Normalize timestamps to UTC after applying the merchant's declared close timezone. A late arrival is included only in the next eligible snapshot.

passages.label: Payout rounding variance
passages.text: A zero tolerance applies to the three signed settlement differences. Record the residual in integer cents and retain the original line items.

passages.label: Resolved case approval
passages.text: A reviewer records the evidence references and reason code before accepting a proposed settlement explanation.

passages.label: Incomplete source coverage
passages.text: If any source coverage watermark is before merchant close, request the missing source interval before considering a payout balanced.

passages.label: Card number in case notes
passages.text: Use an approved token or masked last four digits in case notes; do not paste the full card number.

passages.label: Suspicious activity review
passages.text: Send a suspicious activity referral through the restricted investigations queue using the internal case identifier only.

passages.label: Closed dispute file retention
passages.text: Retain the evidence packet for a closed card dispute for twelve months following final adjudication.

passages.label: Analyst export retention
passages.text: The temporary analyst export expires after seven calendar days and may be regenerated from the audit record.

passages.label: Replacement payout account
passages.text: Verify new settlement account ownership through the secure verification workflow and require independent reviewer approval before the first payout.

passages.label: Account takeover alert
passages.text: For an unexpected payout-account change, call the verified merchant contact from onboarding records and freeze outgoing payouts pending review.

passages.label: Beneficiary name mismatch
passages.text: A mismatch between the settlement bank beneficiary and merchant legal name requires a documented ownership exception from Compliance Operations.

passages.text: When two incoming bank credits have the same amount and posting day, request the bank trace from the processor before assigning either credit.

passages.label: No posted credit
passages.text: If an automatic payout has no posted bank credit, wait two business days after the expected posting date before opening a bank investigation.

passages.label: Same-day cutoff
passages.text: The submission cutoff for a same-day automatic payout is 14:30 UTC. Items submitted after the cutoff are handled the next business day.

passages.label: Rejected payout
passages.text: A rejected payout requires the bank's return reason and the original payout identifier before the amount can be released for retry.

passages.label: Value date
passages.text: Use the statement booking date for the close queue. Keep the value date as a separate field for the treasury statement.

passages.label: Truncated statement descriptor
passages.text: A clipped reference suffix is corroborating evidence only. A full end-to-end payment identifier is required for a unique assignment.

passages.label: Proof of delivery
passages.text: For a card-not-present merchandise-not-received chargeback, attach carrier delivery confirmation showing the delivery address and completion date.

passages.label: Acquirer dispute deadline
passages.text: Submit the evidence packet to the acquirer at least two business days before the case-specific response deadline in the dispute portal.

passages.label: Duplicate charge
passages.text: For a duplicate processing dispute, attach both authorization identifiers and the capture timestamps so the acquirer can distinguish the transactions.

passages.label: Refund proof
passages.text: For a credit-not-processed dispute, supply the settled refund reference and receipt timestamp. A pending refund receipt is insufficient.

passages.label: Issuer review window
passages.text: The issuer's decision window begins after the representment packet is accepted by the acquirer. Use the case-specific deadline in the dispute portal.

passages.label: Digital delivery
passages.text: For a digital service dispute, attach account access logs and activation details instead of a physical carrier receipt.

passages.label: Missing merchant refund
passages.text: When the processor settled a refund missing from the merchant ledger, retain the original purchase identifier, refund event and settlement line before requesting a ledger correction.

passages.label: Closed card account
passages.text: A refund must first be attempted on the original payment instrument. If the issuer returns it, escalate with the rejection reference to Payments Operations.

passages.label: Multiple partial refunds
passages.text: The sum of settled partial refunds cannot exceed the original captured purchase amount. Pending attempts are reviewed separately.

passages.label: Uncaptured authorization
passages.text: Void an uncaptured authorization to release the hold. A refund is available after capture.

passages.label: Refund batch cutoff
passages.text: The scheduled refund batch closes at 17:00 UTC. A refund initiated later enters the following business day's batch.

passages.label: Refund velocity release approval
passages.text: For a payout paused because refund velocity breached its alert limit, the release requires sign-off from Payments Risk.

passages.label: Identity verification release
passages.text: Compliance Operations clears holds linked to outstanding merchant identity verification after the case has the approved review decision.

passages.label: Rolling reserve release
passages.text: A reserve maturity releases on the next scheduled automatic payout after the ledger's reserve release event posts.

passages.label: Negative available balance
passages.text: If merchant available funds are negative, stop discretionary payout retries and open a Collections review with the current balance snapshot.

passages.label: Bank return rate freeze
passages.text: A high bank return rate freeze requires approval from Bank Risk before settlement can resume.

passages.label: Duplicate invoice debit
passages.text: Two invoice debits with the same invoice and amount require comparison of their bank references before a duplicate reversal is raised.

passages.label: Invoice fee breakdown
passages.text: A merchant requesting a fee breakdown receives the invoice identifier, the affected service codes and the billing period.

passages.label: Sales discount mismatch
passages.text: Attach the signed commercial amendment and invoice item before adjusting a fee that differs from the contracted discount.

passages.label: Line item rounding
passages.text: Round each taxable fee line to currency precision before summing the invoice. Retain the original unrounded taxable base for audit.

passages.label: Insufficient funds ACH return
passages.text: An R01 retry requires current authorization and a fresh available-balance check before resubmission.

passages.label: No account ACH return
passages.text: An R03 return goes to bank account correction. Do not resubmit until the replacement account is verified.

passages.label: Consumer disputes ACH debit
passages.text: Route an R10 consumer unauthorized debit to ACH Risk and suspend retries on the authorization until review is complete.

passages.label: Missing ACH return file
passages.text: If a return file is late, ask Bank Integrations for the file sequence number and processing acknowledgement.

passages.text: The domestic same-day ACH debit cutoff is 13:00 UTC. International transfers use a separate schedule.

passages.text: The sum of settled partial refunds cannot exceed the original captured purchase amount. Pending attempts are reviewed separately.

passages.label: Uncaptured authorization
passages.text: Void an uncaptured authorization to release the hold. A refund is available after capture.

passages.label: Refund batch cutoff
passages.text: The scheduled refund batch closes at 17:00 UTC. A refund initiated later enters the following business day's batch.

passages.label: Refund velocity release approval
passages.text: For a payout paused because refund velocity breached its alert limit, the release requires sign-off from Merchant Risk.

passages.label: Identity verification release
passages.text: Compliance Operations clears holds linked to outstanding merchant identity verification after the case has the approved review decision.

passages.label: Rolling reserve release
passages.text: A reserve maturity releases on the next scheduled automatic payout after the ledger's reserve release event posts.

passages.label: Negative available balance
passages.text: If merchant available funds are negative, stop discretionary payout retries and open a Collections review with the current balance snapshot.

passages.label: Bank return rate freeze
passages.text: A high bank return rate freeze requires approval from Bank Risk before settlement can resume.

passages.label: Duplicate invoice debit
passages.text: Two invoice debits with the same invoice and amount require comparison of their bank references before a duplicate reversal is raised.

passages.label: Invoice fee breakdown
passages.text: A merchant requesting a fee breakdown receives the invoice identifier, the affected service codes and the billing period.

passages.label: Sales discount mismatch
passages.text: Attach the signed commercial amendment and invoice item before adjusting a fee that differs from the contracted discount.

passages.label: Line item rounding
passages.text: Round each taxable fee line to currency precision before summing the invoice. Retain the original unrounded taxable base for audit.

passages.label: Insufficient funds ACH return
passages.text: An R01 retry requires current authorization and a fresh available-balance check before resubmission.

passages.label: No account ACH return
passages.text: An R03 return goes to bank account correction. Do not resubmit until the replacement account is verified.

passages.label: Consumer disputes ACH debit
passages.text: Route an R10 consumer unauthorized debit to ACH Risk and suspend retries on the authorization until review is complete.

passages.label: Missing ACH return file
passages.text: If a return file is late, ask Bank Integrations for the file sequence number and processing acknowledgement.

passages.label: Domestic same-day ACH debit cutoff
passages.text: The domestic same-day ACH debit cutoff is 13:00 UTC. International transfers use a separate schedule.

passages.label: Corrected source file
passages.text: Preserve the original accepted input and store the corrected feed as a superseding snapshot with its own file digest and version.

passages.label: Exact import replay
passages.text: An identical input file for the same source is idempotent. The source digest is the replay key.

passages.label: Merchant close timezone
passages.text: Normalize timestamps to UTC after applying the merchant's declared close timezone. A late arrival is included only in the next eligible snapshot.

passages.label: Payout rounding variance
passages.text: A zero tolerance applies to the three signed settlement differences. Record the residual in integer cents and retain the original line items.

passages.label: Resolved case approval
passages.text: A reviewer records the evidence references and reason code before accepting a proposed settlement explanation.

passages.label: Incomplete source coverage
passages.text: If any source coverage watermark is before merchant close, request the missing source interval before considering a payout balanced.

passages.label: Card number in case notes
passages.text: Use an approved token or masked last four digits in case notes; do not paste the full card number.

passages.label: Suspicious activity review
passages.text: Send a suspicious activity referral through the restricted investigations queue using the internal case identifier only.

passages.label: Closed dispute file retention
passages.text: Retain the evidence packet for a closed card dispute for twelve months following final adjudication.

passages.label: Analyst export retention
passages.text: The temporary analyst export expires after seven calendar days and may be regenerated from the audit record.

passages.label: Replacement payout account
passages.text: Verify new settlement account ownership through the secure verification workflow and require independent reviewer approval before the first payout.

passages.label: Account takeover alert
passages.text: For an unexpected payout-account change, call the verified merchant contact from onboarding records and freeze outgoing payouts pending review.

passages.label: Beneficiary name mismatch
passages.text: A mismatch between the settlement bank beneficiary and merchant legal name requires a documented ownership exception from Compliance Operations.

passages.label: Card dispute filing fee
passages.text: Charged to open a card dispute case.

passages.label: Card dispute evidence packet fee
passages.text: Charged when preparing a card dispute representment packet.

passages.label: Card dispute withdrawal fee
passages.text: Charged for withdrawing a representment request.

passages.label: Card dispute escalation fee
passages.text: Charged when a card dispute advances to pre-arbitration.

passages.label: Bank payout trace fee
passages.text: Charged for obtaining a bank trace on an automatic payout.

passages.label: Rejected payout retry fee
passages.text: Charged for resubmitting a returned bank payout after approval.

passages.label: Payout wire recall fee
passages.text: Charged for submitting a payout wire recall request.

passages.label: Payout stop payment fee
passages.text: Charged for a stop order against an unposted disbursement.

passages.label: Domestic ACH return handling fee
passages.text: Charged for processing one domestic ACH return.

passages.label: Domestic ACH debit retry fee
passages.text: Charged for resubmitting a domestic ACH debit.

passages.label: ACH account correction fee
passages.text: Charged when a notification of change requires correction of ACH account details.

passages.label: Duplicate bank statement fee
passages.text: Charged for a replacement copy of an archived bank statement.

passages.label: Payout history export fee
passages.text: Charged for a nonstandard off-cycle export of historical payouts.

passages.label: Currency instruction repair fee
passages.text: Charged to repair an incorrect settlement currency instruction.
